# Your first render

Pick any notebook. The renderer writes a single HTML file next to it.

## Render once

```bash
dsestu-render analysis.py        # marimo
dsestu-render analysis.ipynb     # Jupyter
```

The output is `analysis.html`: one self-contained file with fonts, scripts and data inlined, which you can email or drop on a shared drive.

## Live preview

`--watch` re-renders whenever the notebook or its saved outputs change, and reloads the browser at the same scroll position:

```bash
dsestu-render analysis.py --watch
```

## Where the output goes

Use `-o` to write somewhere else, and pass any other flag through to `quarto render`:

```bash
dsestu-render analysis.py -o reports/2026-10.html -M title:"October review"
```
